links.outcome: Reading grade level of original online breast reconstruction education texts
links.effect: Original texts had mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level 11.2, Gunning Fog 13.9, and Coleman-Liau 11.3, well above the 6th-grade target.
links.quote: The mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level, the Gunning Fog index, and the Coleman-Liau index for the original texts were 11.2, 13.9, and 11.3.

links.outcome: Readability and understandability of AI-simplified versus original patient education materials
links.effect: AI translations had lower grade levels (FK 8.6, Fog 10.5, CL 9.7; all p<0.001) and higher understandability (0.70 vs 0.58, p<0.001); actionability 0.40 vs 0.37, p=0.057.
links.quote: The mean understandability (0.70 SD = 0.06 vs. 0.58 SD = 0.08, p < 0.001) and actionability (0.40, SD = 0.09 vs. 0.37 SD = 0.11, p = 0.057) scores of the artificial intelligence-translations were higher than that of the original texts upon Patient Education Materials Assessment Tool analysis.

links.outcome: Understandability and actionability of patient education materials
links.effect: Understandability 0.70 vs. 0.58, p < 0.001; actionability 0.40 vs. 0.37, p = 0.057.
links.quote: The mean understandability (0.70 SD = 0.06 vs. 0.58 SD = 0.08, p < 0.001) and actionability (0.40, SD = 0.09 vs. 0.37 SD = 0.11, p = 0.057) scores of the artificial intelligence-translations were higher than that of the original texts upon Patient Education Materials Assessment Tool analysis.

links.outcome: Readability grade levels after AI simplification
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid 11.2 to 8.6; Gunning Fog 13.9 to 10.5; Coleman-Liau 11.3 to 9.7; all p < 0.001.
links.quote: The mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level, the Gunning Fog index, and the Coleman-Liau index for the AI-translated counterparts were 8.6, 10.5, and 9.7 (all p < 0.001).

links.effect: mean FKGL 8.6, GFI 10.5, and CLI 9.7 (all p < 0.001) for AI translations instructed to reach 6th-grade level
